title: Moving a register head
statement: Let $m,d,k_D\in\mathbb N$, let $\Lambda$ and $SD$ be state types, and let $x$ be a Boolean input. For any optional control state, input-head position, register tapes and head positions, decider tapes and head positions, output word, register $r\in\mathrm{Fin}(m)$, movement $mv\in\{-1,0,1\}$, and new control state $st'\in\mathrm{CSt}(\Lambda,SD,m)$, the action that leaves the input head and tapes unchanged, moves register $r$ by $mv$, leaves all decider heads fixed, and enters $st'$ transforms the configuration into the one with state $st'$ and register-head position at $r$ increased by $mv$, with all other specified data unchanged.
